dimensions.input_boss_correction: Restore the original central cavity through inboard input-boss stock; external casting outline retained.

joints.standard_engagement: starboard/right bevel wheel, ahead motion per HB119
joints.joint_assumption: Six short rivets join gear/sleeve. Six interleaved longer rivets include the quarter-inch clutch-ring flange; short heads have explicit access recesses.

wheel.limits: Spherical-involute flanks with chordal caps/roots/tips; root fillets and manufactured corrections absent.

pinion.limits: Spherical-involute flanks with chordal caps/roots/tips; root fillets and manufactured corrections absent.
